name: python-batch-inference
title: Python batch inference runner
blurb: Resumable batch inference over any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: JSONL in and out, bounded concurrency, exponential back-off on 408/429/5xx, failures recorded instead of thrown, and a rerun that skips what is already answered
default_description: A resumable batch inference runner for chat models.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --quiet --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --quiet --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

verify.name: stdin
verify.cmd: printf '{"id":"s1","prompt":"hi"}\n' | .venv/bin/python -m {{ package_name }} run --requests - --out /tmp/batch-stdin-check.jsonl --base-url http://127.0.0.1:9/v1 --max-attempts 1 --backoff 0 --timeout 1 >/tmp/batch-stdin-check.log 2>&1; status=$?; rm -f /tmp/batch-stdin-check.jsonl /tmp/batch-stdin-check.log; test "$status" -eq 1

detect.contains: Batch inference that survives being interrupted
